instance.expected_answer: Incident INC_041 was caused by app release APPV_CZ_530.

claims.statement: APPV_CZ_530 is evidence of the planted pattern.
DOC_0251 is evidence of the planted pattern.

A.answer: The root cause of incident INC_041 is identified as RC_31 [1]. This incident involved checkout stalls on iOS devices following the release of app version APPV_CZ_530, which caused the application to freeze at the checkout stage for users of games such as Moravia Multi and Rychle Cisla [1], [2]. Support cases linked to this incident confirm that the application froze after updating to version 5.3.0 [5], [6], [7], [8].
